setup: Sample data. Describe your distro, desktop, GPU and display here. Launch strings assume gamemode and MangoHud are installed.

games.name: Apex Legends
games.notes: Blocked by anti-cheat: EAC (Linux disabled by EA, Oct 2024). EA disabled Linux/Proton access in late 2024. Requires Windows.

games.name: Borderlands 2
games.notes: Proton: native port is outdated (pre-2019), runs worse, lacks newer DLC and can't play with Windows players. Force Proton in Compatibility settings before installing. Flags skip the SHiFT launcher and intro movies.

games.name: Counter-Strike 2
games.notes: Native only (Source 2 Vulkan). Use Fullscreen at your native resolution in-game.

games.name: Cyberpunk 2077
games.notes: No Denuvo. Use in-game FSR for upscaling, not gamescope.

games.name: Portal 2
games.notes: Proton: native port has resolution-detection problems on modern setups; the Windows build via DXVK is smoother.

games.name: Stardew Valley
games.notes: Native build is excellent; SMAPI mods have a Linux installer.
